mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for luxury pool construction in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of luxury pool construction in Los Angeles varies significantly based on size, features, materials, and site complexity. Basic luxury pools might start around $150,000, while highly customized designs with advanced features like infinity edges, integrated spas, elaborate landscaping, and smart automation systems can exceed $500,000. Factors such as soil conditions, hillside construction, and accessibility to the site also impact the final price. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation and site assessment.
